permissionSteps.title: Photos
permissionSteps.purpose: Echo reads your photo library locally to index and search images and videos.
permissionSteps.icloudHint: For complete memories, set iCloud Photos to 'Download and Keep Originals' or download before using Echo. Optimized storage may not be recognizable.

permissionSteps.title: Notifications
permissionSteps.purpose: Echo sends local reminders to surface your memories.

permissionSteps.title: Location
permissionSteps.purpose: Echo can wake with memories tied to where you are.

permissionSteps.title: Health
permissionSteps.purpose: Echo reads health context to enrich memory awakening (raw values are not stored).
